standard_prerequisites.name: W-types
standard_prerequisites.statement: For A a type and B a family over A, the W-type of B has a constructor taking a : A and t : B(a) to W and satisfies an elimination rule with a computation rule.
standard_prerequisites.use: The introduction rule gives the structure map at source line 532 and the elimination and computation rules give the homomorphism at source lines 536-537.

standard_prerequisites.name: Polynomial functor and algebra
standard_prerequisites.statement: The polynomial functor of A and B sends X to the type of pairs (a,t) with a : A and t : B(a) to X, and an algebra is a type with a map from its functor image.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the functor P and the algebras (W,s_W) and (C,s_C) of source lines 530-535.

standard_prerequisites.name: Algebra homomorphism and 2-cell
standard_prerequisites.statement: A homomorphism is a map together with a homotopy witnessing commutation with the structure maps, and a 2-cell between homomorphisms is a pair of a homotopy between the maps and a higher witness between the two pasting diagrams.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the reduction of an identity of homomorphisms performed at source lines 543-558.

standard_prerequisites.name: Function extensionality
standard_prerequisites.statement: A pointwise homotopy between two functions gives an equality of functions.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is named at source line 559 as the tool that produces the path between the two homomorphisms.

core_obligations: Fix A and B, set P(X) to be the type of pairs (a,t) with a : A and t : B(a) to X, and let W be the W-type of B with structure map sup (source lines 529-532).

Given an arbitrary algebra (C,s_C), use the elimination rule of W together with its computation rule to define a homomorphism from (W,s_W) to (C,s_C), which shows the type of homomorphisms is inhabited (source lines 536-537).

Show that any two homomorphisms are equal by replacing the identity type of homomorphisms with the type of algebra 2-cells, whose elements are pairs of a homotopy between the underlying maps and a higher identity between two pasting diagrams displayed in the retained proof (source lines 543-558).

Produce the required homotopy between the underlying maps by function extensionality together with W-elimination, choosing it so that the coherence datum of the 2-cell also exists (source lines 559-561).
Conclude that the type of homomorphisms out of (W,s_W) is contractible for every algebra, that is, that (W,s_W) is homotopy-initial (source lines 534-535 and 562).

proof_roadmap.step: Set up the polynomial functor, the algebra (W,s_W) and the type of homomorphisms to be shown contractible.
Inhabit that type using the elimination and computation rules of W.
Replace an identity of homomorphisms by the type of algebra 2-cells with its pasting diagrams.
Build the homotopy by function extensionality and W-elimination so that the 2-cell exists.

difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the labelled theorem thm:w-hinit at source lines 524-526: for every A and every family B over A the W-algebra of the polynomial functor is homotopy-initial. The author's proof (source lines 528-562) is announced as a sketch and its hard step is not the existence of the homomorphism, which comes straight from W-elimination and the computation rule (source lines 536-537), but the contractibility of the type of homomorphisms. For that the proof replaces an identity of homomorphisms by the type of algebra 2-cells, pairs consisting of a homotopy between the underlying maps and a higher identity between two pasting diagrams printed as commuting squares (source lines 543-556), and it then has to build that homotopy by function extensionality together with W-elimination in such a way that the coherence datum exists as well (source lines 559-561). The statement contains neither the 2-cell reformulation nor the constraint that the homotopy has to be chosen to carry the coherence.
